verdict.rationale: Supabase documents official client libraries: vector embeddings are queried via 'the Supabase client libraries', and image transformations note client-library support. llms.txt publishes per-language reference corpora for JS, Dart, Swift, Kotlin, Python and C#, and type generation produces a typed `database.types.ts` for building against the APIs. Missing for 10: a dedicated SDK reference page with install and usage details in the pack, explicit confirmation that each language library is first-party, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
